  Code Mode (experimental)

  In Code Mode, Claude works by writing and running JavaScript that calls its tools, instead of calling them one at a time.

  This is an early experiment. It can behave differently from normal Claude Code, and it may change or be removed in any release.

  A session that you start in Code Mode can be resumed only with Code Mode on. If you turn Code Mode off, turn it on again to resume the session. Where Code Mode isn't available, the session can't be resumed: cloud
  sessions and the Claude apps can't continue it, and older versions of Claude Code may open it but not work properly in it.

  Sessions start in the same permission mode as without Code Mode, which can be auto mode where it's available. In auto mode, the safety check reads each piece of JavaScript once, before it runs. It doesn't check each
  tool call that the code then makes, so it can't see values that the code works out as it runs.

  ❯ No, start without it
    Yes, turn on Code Mode

  Tell us how it goes with /feedback

  Enter to confirm · Esc to start without it
